grades.reason: It covers POSIX condition variables, pthread_cond_wait and signal/broadcast, plus a pause-flag example. It never says why the wait belongs in a while loop, so it gives only background.

grades.quote: Other threads that don’t care can simply go back to waiting.
grades.reason: It partly explains the rationale. Woken threads that don't find their condition true just go back to waiting, which means they re-check the condition in a loop. It also refers to waiting threads running an identical while loop. It never states the while-loop rule outright, and it doesn't mention spurious wakeups or the state changing before the mutex is reacquired.
